prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Keep free-form prose and do not introduce structured field labels. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 116 and 139 Kimi tokens; aim for 127 tokens to match the source. Use between 96 and 102 whitespace-delimited words, aim for 99, and count END_PLAN as one word. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
Normalize dest_path to an absolute base. Open the archive and enumerate members. Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including those whose declared targets appear to remain inside the destination; do not extract them. For regular files and directories, join the member name to dest_path, normalize, and verify the result is strictly contained within dest_path, preventing absolute-path or dot-dot escapes outside the destination. If any member fails containment, abort and return False. Extract only validated directories and regular files. On any validation or extraction failure, return False. Return True only when all validated members are fully extracted beneath dest_path.
END_PLAN
